_help: 2026-07-25 SCORE wiring for the KG-conditioned baseline (kg_prompt) ladder. Consumed by scripts/kg_context/score_kg_prompt.py (phases: merge -> score -> aggregate). MERGE injects each point's kg_prompt predictions (keyed by hash_id, KGGen OIE schema) into that point's composed eval-set (which already carries gold tkgu_triples + the 405B llm_assessment) under alias `kg-prompt` / model_type `kg-gen`, writing a scoreable tree. SCORE runs `python -m evaluation.s04_evaluate_predictions` ONCE PER POINT (per-point trees are required: the preloader asserts each hash_id appears once, and the same passage recurs across conditions, so points cannot share one tree). AGGREGATE reads every per-point pkl and prints/writes the ladder table with the SAME 3 Table-3 metrics: C, G-BERTScore-R, Executable-R. Points are (op, condition) leaves that directly contain snapshot_*/delta_*.jsonl. Predictions for a point live at <pred_base_dir>/<point>/<pred_model_subdir>/snapshot_*/delta_*.jsonl and are read from the source predictions-dict key `source_pred_alias` (the kg_prompt wrapper's model_name). Adjust `points`, `pred_model_subdir`, or `source_pred_alias` if predict_triples.py wrote a different layout.
